sch-3-sec-1.summary: Validations relating to the Australian Crime Commission

logicApplications.summary: Validations for authorizations and determinations
logicApplications.premise: The Board of the Australian Crime Commission gave an authorization or made a determination.
logicApplications.conclusion: The thing done is as valid and effective, and is taken for all purposes always to have been as valid and effective.

logicApplications.summary: Applies to federally relevant criminal activity within the meaning of the ACC Act
logicApplications.premise: The thing done relates to federally relevant criminal activity within the meaning of the ACC Act as in force at the time when the authorization was given or the determination was made.
logicApplications.conclusion: The thing done is valid and effective for all purposes if it relates to federally relevant criminal activity within the meaning of the ACC Act.

logicApplications.summary: Within a specific time period
logicApplications.premise: The authorization or determination was given on or after 4 September 2013 and before 10 December 2022.
logicApplications.conclusion: The thing done is valid and effective within the specified time period.

logicApplications.summary: Always applies
logicApplications.premise: The thing done is as valid and effective, and is taken for all purposes always to have been as valid and effective.
logicApplications.conclusion: The thing done is always valid and effective.

logicApplications.summary: Validations for acquisitions of property
logicApplications.premise: If the operation of this item would result in an acquisition of property from a person otherwise than on just terms.
logicApplications.conclusion: The Commonwealth is liable to pay a reasonable amount of compensation to the person.

logicApplications.summary: Validations for legal proceedings
logicApplications.premise: Legal proceedings include any proceedings before a court or tribunal, and include proceedings that are pending or concluded.
logicApplications.conclusion: The thing done is as valid and effective, and is taken for all purposes always to have been as valid and effective.
